rules.text: Vibrant, effective energy; composed and competent; admires courage; seen as strong, not easily swayed

source.quote: People perceive your strength and recognize that you cannot be easily swayed

rules.say: People see you as strong, composed and competent, with vibrant energy, and know you cannot be easily swayed. You admire courage.

rules.text: Friendly, approachable, soft exterior; seen as gentle safe haven

source.quote: People view you as a gentle and secure haven

rules.say: You come across as friendly, approachable and soft, and people see you as a gentle, safe haven.

rules.text: Vital, vibrant, inspiring; charming, witty, centre of attention

source.quote: Your wit and sparkling character make you the center of attention

rules.say: You come across as vibrant, charming, witty and inspiring, and you easily become the centre of attention.

rules.text: Family above all; caretaker and guardian; family may overlook your efforts

source.quote: You prioritize your family above all else.

rules.say: You put your family above all and act as its caretaker and guardian, though your family may overlook your efforts.

rules.text: Stimulates others; brings fresh ideas to gatherings; quick wit and charm

source.quote: Social gatherings come alive in your presence

rules.say: You bring fresh ideas, quick wit and charm, and social gatherings come alive in your presence.

rules.text: Understanding, compassionate, seen as warm and fair; attracts people needing support

source.quote: people readily perceive as warm and fair

rules.say: You come across as understanding and compassionate, and people see you as warm and fair. Those who need support are drawn to you.

rules.text: Mysterious, unique; seen as serious and studious; independent; intelligence earns respect

source.quote: You exude an air of mystery and uniqueness

rules.say: You carry an air of mystery and uniqueness and are seen as serious, studious and independent. Your intelligence earns respect.

rules.text: Strength and power; impressive, can intimidate; natural authority; attracts resourceful people
rules.say: You give off strength, power and natural authority, which can impress or even intimidate. You attract resourceful people.

rules.text: Dignified, aristocratic, noble bearing; controls own image
rules.say: You carry yourself with dignity and a noble, aristocratic air, and you control your own image well.

rules.text: Highly perceptive; creative and intellectual; seen as gentle and intellectual

source.quote: People perceive you gentle and intellectual person.

rules.say: You are highly perceptive, creative and intellectual, and people see you as gentle and intellectual.

rules.text: Dependable, steadfast; seen as a pillar of a business

source.quote: People perceive you as a pillar within a business

rules.say: You come across as dependable and steadfast, and people see you as a pillar of any business.

rules.text: Inspires confidence; sense of justice; keeps harmony, sacrifices own desires

source.quote: You have a fine sense of justice.

rules.say: You inspire confidence and have a fine sense of justice. You keep harmony around you, even at the cost of your own desires.
